source.title: Casinos Secrets: Wer casht ab mit illegalen Casinos?
source.note: German investigative documentary by a Casino Secrets media partner. Summaries below paraphrase what the film says; they are claims by the film, not findings of this project. People the film only names by initials are not named here either.

mentions.claim: Platin Casino, described as one of the largest illegal casinos aimed at German players, is said to be closely linked to SoftSwiss; SoftSwiss says the operator is an independent company it at most supplied with software or game access.

The film attributes more than 1,000 Curaçao-licensed online casinos to a SoftSwiss network, at least 388 of them aimed at German players; SoftSwiss denies operating casinos or being behind the network.

Dama N.V. passed from the SoftSwiss founder to a 67-year-old woman from Georgia on the day Germany's new gambling treaty took effect (2021); on paper she is the beneficial owner of a company that took in more than EUR 1 billion in 2024.

A Curaçao Gaming Authority compliance memo doubted the owner had the means or experience, suspected SoftSwiss enjoys most of the profit and noted Germany as a target market; the licence was granted anyway. The authority says the memo was not a final assessment and that the network was 'fabricated'.
About 250 gambling sites were registered through these companies by April 2026.
Platin Casino earlier belonged to a Malta company (Retrino Limited); after a German player won a court case, the casino had been sold to Curaçao and the Malta company was left without assets.
